description.en-US: The channel this point belongs to. Immutable (CR 72): a point created under the wrong channel is archived and recreated, never moved, because orders already reference the pair and moving it would rewrite what channel those sales happened in.

A human-facing local code such as 'VM000123'. Optional, mutable, and unique within its channel when present (D-21). Deliberately not an integration identity: nothing resolves a sales point by this, so unlike a channel code it can be corrected after the fact (CR 13). The uniqueness is a hand-written partial index in the migration, not partial_uniques: that builder scopes a required field by a nullable one and would also emit a unique index over sales_channel_id alone where this is NULL, permitting only one un-coded point per channel.

The creating module's own id for the thing this point represents — for a kiosk, its Kiosk id (CR 12). Unique within a channel when present, and that pair IS the idempotency mechanism: a vending module retrying CreateSalesPoint after a timeout resolves to the existing point instead of creating a second one (CR 48). Immutable, because changing it would break that resolution. Like the code above, the uniqueness is a hand-written partial index in the migration rather than partial_uniques, whose second index would cap a channel at one point with no external reference.

The business lifecycle. Suspended stops new orders while leaving returns, refunds and history working (CR 14), which is what a temporarily offline kiosk needs. Distinct from is_archived. Written only by the suspend and activate actions.
